quotes.text: The create/edit dialog is a custom element in top-level application chrome and shares that host window’s Redux store. Use `mail/base/content/state/store.mjs`, inject feature slices into `rootReducer`, and follow `storeObserver` lifecycle; route attributes `calendar-id`, `event-id`, and optional `recurrence-id` remain authoritative. [Task 4]
